findings.title: Match the canonical attempt timeline ordering
findings.body: When attempt-number order differs from occurrence-time order, this query supplies a different progression from the published session's canonical timeline. The server's snapshot_session_post_attempt_timeline function in migration 013 orders by attempt_number, occurred_at, id, while composeSessionResultCard draws the supplied array without sorting; valid rows such as attempt #2 occurring before attempt #1 therefore produce #2 → #1 in the exported artwork but #1 → #2 in the same post's feed timeline. Add attempt_number as the primary ordering before the existing timestamp and ID tie-breakers.
